lines.zh: 我踩着石板走过神社的走廊。
lines.en: I cross the shrine corridor over the stone slabs.

lines.zh: 裙摆在台阶上扫起一层灰。
lines.en: My skirt sweeps a layer of dust off the steps.

lines.zh: 我去看看参道有没有人塞钱。
lines.en: I go check the path for any donations.

lines.zh: 这条路我一天要走十几遍。
lines.en: I walk this road a dozen times a day.

lines.zh: 御币垂在手边，一晃一晃。
lines.en: My gohei swings gently at my side.

lines.zh: 绕到后院，井边的桶歪了。
lines.en: Round back, the bucket by the well is askew.

lines.zh: 我去把倒在路边的灯笼扶正。
lines.en: I right a fallen lantern beside the path.
Weeds have sprouted between the slabs again.

lines.zh: 我沿着鸟居下的影子走。
lines.en: I walk along the shade beneath the torii.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，别吵醒殿里的人。
lines.en: I step softly so I don't wake anyone inside.

lines.zh: 巡视一圈，顺路捡捡落叶。
lines.en: I make my rounds, gathering fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 山风把我的袖子吹得鼓起来。
lines.en: The mountain wind fills out my sleeves.

lines.zh: 我要去山门口看看天色。
lines.en: I head for the gate to read the sky.

lines.zh: 走完这一趟就回去泡茶。
lines.en: After this round I'll go brew tea.

lines.zh: 我数着赛钱箱里的铜板。
lines.en: I count the coins in the offering box.
Nobody came to worship today either.

lines.zh: 我拿抹布擦神龛的边角。
lines.en: I wipe the corners of the altar with a cloth.
Basking in the sun makes me want to lie down.

lines.zh: 茶凉了，我还是喝了一口。
lines.en: The tea went cold; I drink it anyway.
I stare blankly at the donation box.
My spell cards must be sorted in order.

lines.zh: 殿前的落叶总也扫不完。
lines.en: The leaves before the hall never stay swept.

lines.zh: 我把御币靠在柱子上晾。
lines.en: I lean my gohei against a pillar to dry.
No clouds today, good for airing bedding.
I sit on the veranda swinging my feet.

lines.zh: 神社安静得能听见虫子。
lines.en: The shrine is quiet enough to hear insects.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸发带，还系得牢。
lines.en: I touch my ribbon; it is still tied tight.
Probably no visitors tomorrow either.

lines.zh: 你站在鸟居下，不进也不退。
lines.en: You stand under the torii, neither in nor out.

lines.zh: 参拜要先洗手，你洗了吗。
lines.en: You wash your hands before worship, right?
You carry the smell of the mountain.
Here for a spell card again?

lines.zh: 你的鞋上沾了泥，进来吧。
lines.en: Your shoes are muddy; come in anyway.

lines.zh: 我看你半天了，你不说话。
lines.en: I've watched you a while and you say nothing.
Don't dawdle in front of the hall.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的东西有点眼熟。
lines.en: That thing at your belt looks familiar.
Do you want directions, or tea?

lines.zh: 你的影子投在赛钱箱上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across the offering box.
I know your sort — idle.
Stand straight; this is a shrine.
What are you eyeing inside the hall?
Speak up; I don't guess.

lines.zh: 你手别插兜，神社里没这规矩。
lines.en: Hands out of your pockets; we do not do that here.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在算香火钱吧。
lines.en: Your eyes are counting the offering money, are they not.
That hurts; you hit hard.
My sleeve is torn open.

lines.zh: 符卡还捏在手里，没有散。
lines.en: My spell card is still in hand, unbroken.
I'm not used to being hit.
Blood on the slabs is hard to sweep.
You've picked the wrong person.
I grit my teeth and hold my ground.
My ribbon loosened; don't fall off.
I'll have to bind this wound later.

lines.zh: 我记住了这一下的位置。
lines.en: I'll remember where that landed.
Just leave that plate of sweets on the table.

lines.zh: 你手里那包东西，闻着甜。
lines.en: That package in your hand smells sweet.
I'm not picky, but warm is better.
Is that for me? Then I'll take it.
Put it down and go; don't watch me eat.
I smell something fried.
Don't fob me off with altar offerings.
This smells far better than tea.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃过像样的了。
lines.en: I haven't had a decent meal in ages.
Feed me and I'll remember the favor.
You bump me; doesn't your shoulder hurt?

lines.zh: 站稳，别把我撞进赛钱箱。
lines.en: Steady; don't knock me into the box.
You're standing on my skirt.
Move aside; the path is only this wide.
You smell of sweat.
Don't crowd me; I'm not running.
Bumping people means apologizing, got it?
You bump harder than you look.
Step back half a pace; that's enough room.
Bump me again and I'll act.

lines.zh: 巫女不嫁人，神社得有人守。
lines.en: A shrine maiden doesn't marry; someone must keep this place.

lines.zh: 我这条发带只给过一次人。
lines.en: I've given this ribbon away only once.

lines.zh: 想留下来？先扫三个月落叶。
lines.en: Want to stay? Sweep leaves for three months first.
Don't count on me being gentle.

lines.zh: 神社缺个烧水的，不缺丈夫。
lines.en: The shrine needs a water-boiler, not a husband.
I like my quiet on my own.

lines.zh: 你若要留，就守住这扇门。
lines.en: If you stay, guard this gate.
I'm not good at this sort of thing.

lines.zh: 陪我把这壶茶喝完再说。
lines.en: Finish this pot of tea with me first.
Don't size me up with those eyes.

lines.zh: 地上这枚铜板归赛钱箱。
lines.en: This coin on the ground belongs in the box.

lines.zh: 我捡起被风吹掉的符纸。
lines.en: I pick up a talisman the wind took.
Who left offerings out on the path?
This flower will do in the vase.
I'll hold on to whatever is dropped.
I stoop to gather the broken tile.
This broom still works.
Everything found has to be written down.
I pick it up first; don't grab.
Dropped before the hall, it belongs to the shrine.

lines.zh: 你刚才在村民面前做了什么。
lines.en: What did you just do in front of those villagers?
I smell blood, and not from livestock.
Stop right there, and wipe your mouth.
Not in front of the shrine.

lines.zh: 你嘴上的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I've noted the smell on your mouth.
Only youkai eat that sort of thing.
I'll have to act today.
You crossed a line, human.
You can't run from here.
Extermination is reason enough.

lines.zh: 我的御币已经抬起来了。
lines.en: My gohei is already raised.

lines.zh: 你还有一次解释的机会。
lines.en: You get one chance to explain.

lines.zh: 你的手放在我看得见的地方。
lines.en: Keep your hands where I can see them.
The spell card is in my sleeve, ready.

lines.zh: 这个距离，正好够我出手。
lines.en: This distance is just right for me to strike.
Your breathing has slipped a beat.
You strike first; I'll answer after.

lines.zh: 这神社每块石板我都认得。
lines.en: I know every slab of this shrine ground.
Don't expect me to hold back.
I won't miss this strike.
My gohei sweeps across your shoulder.
Take this and stay on your feet.
The card lands; don't blame me.
I strike where it counts.
Back three paces and don't come again.
That one was for the villagers.
You block well, but not well enough.
I follow it with another blow.
Don't fall here; it's filthy.
That's done. Now get out.

lines.zh: 神社的铃响了，我醒过来。
lines.en: The shrine bell rings and I wake.

lines.zh: 我从鸟居的影子里走出来。
lines.en: I step out from the torii's shadow.
Another perfectly ordinary morning at the shrine.

lines.zh: 我先看看赛钱箱有没有满。
lines.en: First I check whether the box is full.
The incense burner is still warm — good.
I push the wooden door open from inside.
The mist lifts; I come out for air.
Who moved my broom?

lines.zh: 我整理好衣领，站到阶前。
lines.en: I straighten my collar and stand at the steps.
Someone ought to visit today.
Fire caught the hem of my skirt.

lines.zh: 从台阶上摔下来，膝盖磕了。
lines.en: I fell off the steps and hit my knee.

lines.zh: 水钻进我的袖口，符卡湿透了。
lines.en: Water soaks my sleeves and ruins my spell cards.

lines.zh: 炸起的尘土糊了我一脸。
lines.en: Blast dust cakes my whole face.
An arrow grazed past my ear.
This magic burns like a spell card.
I forgot to eat; my stomach growls.
Lightning struck the torii; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从神社的走廊抽走了。
lines.en: The void pulls me off the shrine's walkway.
